annotations.title: Drug pregnancy and lactation label check

description: Drug pregnancy and lactation label check — What the FDA label says about a medicine in pregnancy and breastfeeding: pregnancy verdict (CONTRAINDICATED, HIGH RISK, LIMITED DATA, LOW RISK SIGNAL, NO KNOWN RISK SIGNAL, NOT IN LABEL) and lactation verdict (AVOID, CAUTION, NO KNOWN RISK SIGNAL, NOT IN LABEL) with the reason, legacy letter category when present, flags (boxed fetal warning, contraindicated, pregnancy test, contraception, REMS, exposure registry, present in milk), label excerpts and a DailyMed link. drug= brand or generic name. FDA SPL via openFDA; informational, not medical advice. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
